articles.title: OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly planting a bug in a conference room
articles.content: An OpenAI engineer was arrested after the company said it discovered a "sophisticated recording device" hidden in one of its offices. The employee was identified as Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old Saudi national.
